cmd:
cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo
echo "=== gc.log ==="; cat .git/gc.log
echo "=== reachable total ==="; git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objectsize)' | awk '{s+=$1;n++} END{printf "%d objs, %.1f MB\n",n,s/1048576}'
echo "=== biggest reachable blobs ==="; git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objectsize) %(rest)' | sort -rn | head -8
echo "=== path totals reachable ==="; git rev-list --objects --all | git cat-file --batch-check='%(objectsize) %(rest)' | awk '{split($2,a,"/"); k=a[1]"/"a[2]; s[k]+=$1} END{for(k in s) printf "%.0f MB %s\n", s[k]/1048576,k}' | sort -rn | head -8
echo "=== fetch/gc in code ==="; grep -rnE "git (fetch|gc|repack|prune)|update-shallow|--depth" scripts/*.py scripts/*.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -c1-170 | head -25
echo "=== cron gc ==="; crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "gc|repack|prune"; sudo crontab -l 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "gc|repack|prune"
echo "=== shallow dup/unique ==="; sort -u .git/shallow | wc -l
echo "=== older packs mtime ==="; ls -la --time-style=long-iso .git/objects/pack/*.pack | awk '{print $6,$7,$5}' | sort | head -4
